concerns.text: The DSRT scores are cited from the HuggingFace dataset `dsrtrain/augmath_prompt` (https://huggingface.co/datasets/dsrtrain/augmath_prompt/resolve/main/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet). This dataset name suggests it contains augmented math prompts, not a validated Domain‑Specific Risk‑Taking (DSRT) behavioral measure. Using an unrelated dataset would provide an inappropriate outcome variable for the hypothesis, jeopardizing the scientific validity of the analysis.

The plan schedules 5 000 Freedman‑Lane permutations for each of the 400 parcels (≈ 2 million OLS fits). On a CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner this workload is likely to exceed the 6‑hour CI wall‑clock limit, especially given the additional overhead of loading data and computing entropy. The feasibility estimate of ~3 h appears optimistic and may cause the pipeline to time‑out, violating SC‑001 and SC‑002.
